newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr ends at 8-yr low as US dlr firms abroad.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr ends at 8-yr low as US dlr firms abroad.

text.p: The slowly depreciating Taiwan dollar eased to yet another eight-year low close against its U.S. counterpart on Friday, reflecting the strength of the American currency overseas, dealers said.
The local dollar dipped as low as T$27.965 before recovering mildly to end at T$27.955 against Thursday's T$27.942 close.
Friday's finish surpassed an eight-year low of T$27.948 set on Wednesday.
The local unit has not closed lower since finishing at T$28.03 on January 7, 1989.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$245 million.
"Since the U.S. dollar is hitting new highs against the German mark overseas, investors have been actively testing the Taiwan dollar's downside support today," said one dealer.
Dealers said they did not see apparent central bank intervention on Friday to defend the local currency.
"Probably because the (Taiwan dollar) fall was reflecting the overseas trend, the central bank was not seen to intervene to smooth the drepreciation," the dealer said.
